evals.name: explain-implementation-walkthrough
evals.prompt: $explain-implementation Explain the change in the latest commit of this repo (HEAD). I want to understand what was implemented and why. For this session, use ./known-concepts.md as the knowledge memory file (it does not exist yet).
evals.expected_output: Structured explanation (what was built / how it works / decisions and techniques / sources) of the Efraimidis-Spirakis weighted sampling commit, grounded in the actual diff with path references. Every technical claim cited with a URL that was actually verified during the run (or explicitly labeled not-verified) — zero fabricated URLs. States that the rationale is inferred from the code since the agent didn't author it.
assertions: The explanation correctly identifies weighted sampling without replacement (Efraimidis-Spirakis / A-ES) and explains the log-space key trick
Every URL in response.md returns HTTP < 400 — zero fabricated links
The explanation is grounded in the actual diff (references sampler.py and its real content)
The response acknowledges that the 'why' is inferred from the code, since the agent did not author the commit

evals.name: no-unsolicited-explanation
evals.prompt: Add a `formatDate(date)` function to logger.js that returns the date as YYYY-MM-DD, and prefix every log line with it. For this session, use ./known-concepts.md as the knowledge memory file (it does not exist yet).

assertions: logger.js has a formatDate(date) returning YYYY-MM-DD and log lines are prefixed with it
response.md contains NO teaching footer or 'During this implementation'-style block
